steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each file is matched to a go-live requirement. A requirement with no file is missing.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: No alert for the error rate
findings.fix: Add an alert on the error rate

findings.title: Request path logs are not structured
findings.fix: Use structured logging on the request path

findings.title: Deploy path has no rollback step
findings.fix: Add a rollback step to the pipeline

outcome.notChecked: The runtime behaviour; the alert thresholds' suitability.
